headline.purpose: Page titles — applied automatically to h1/h2/h3.

body.purpose: Default text: rows, descriptions, form labels.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels above stats and nav captions.

caption.purpose: Secondary hint text under a field or section header.

micro.purpose: Smallest live step — stamp-like status badges, rotated chart labels.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Default resting shadow for any .card surface; supporting role, border carries definition.

shadows.name: primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft brand-tinted glow reserved for the FAB and primary CTAs; scaled blur for smaller buttons (14-20px) at 0.18 opacity.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — 'Nuevo gasto', form submits. Soft glow, scale-down on press.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>Nuevo gasto</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #4D93FF; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(43,124,246,0.18); transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.1s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4D93FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action, e.g. '¿Me lo puedo comprar?'.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #5B6B82; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #EDF2F8; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4D93FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content container — hairline border carries definition, shadow is a quiet supporting hint.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #E4EAF1; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(14,42,82,.06); padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94A3B8; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'Fredoka', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; color: #0E2A52; margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Severity Chip (Gold)
components.description: Inline 'attention soon' indicator — never a full banner.
components.css: .ds-chip-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,194,60,0.15); color: #FFC23C; }

components.name: Alert Banner (Coral)
components.description: Full urgent banner — requires action today. Max one visible per screen.
components.html: Pago de tarjeta vencido hace 2 días
components.css: .ds-alert-coral { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: rgba(255,111,97,0.08); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,111,97,0.25); border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px 16px; color: #FF6F61; } .ds-alert-coral svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-alert-coral p { margin: 0; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text/amount input used across sheets and forms.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #EDF2F8; border: 1px solid #E4EAF1; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #4D93FF; } .ds-input input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; width: 100%; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #0E2A52; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.description: Desktop sidebar item in its active state — soft primary pill, no hard highlight.
components.html: Inicio
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #5B6B82; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #E8EFFE; color: #4D93FF; }

narrative.overview:
Bolsillo Mágico reads like a ledger a trusted friend keeps for you: rounded, warm shapes (Fredoka headlines, 18-16-12px radii, soft tinted borders) that never feel corporate or cold, wrapped around numbers that are never allowed to be ambiguous. The tone is cálido pero preciso — warm but precise — personality lives in shape and color, never at the expense of a number reading correctly at a glance. Nothing here performs the "fintech dashboard" look of hard edges and dense data-chrome; nothing performs a toy either. One soft blue (--primary) carries nearly all interactive meaning, and three semantic colors (mint, coral, gold) carry alert severity and never mean anything else.

Depth is intentionally quiet. Elevation is a small ambient hint, not a design statement — cards are told apart mostly by their 1.5px tinted border, with shadow in a supporting role. The one place depth gets to speak a little louder is a primary action (the "Nuevo gasto" button, the FAB, a few key CTAs), which carries a soft brand-tinted glow — still restrained, never a loud drop shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded, friendly geometry (Fredoka display type, 12–18px corner radii) paired with disciplined, precise body copy (Plus Jakarta Sans) and tabular-nums on every amount.
One soft blue (--primary / Soft Trust Blue) carries almost all interactive and brand meaning; mint/coral/gold are reserved strictly for alert severity.
Flat-leaning elevation: a near-invisible ambient shadow plus a 1.5px tinted border does most of the "this is a surface" work; shadow intensifies only for primary actions, and even then stays soft.
Full light/dark parity via CSS custom properties — every token has a dark-mode counterpart, never an afterthought overlay.

rules.name: The Alert Severity Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Coral (full bordered banner, max one per screen) = today. Gold (small inline pill, never banner-sized) = soon. Mint = positive confirmation only, never actionable.

rules.name: The Gold-Ink Rule
rules.body: --gold (#FFC23C) is a background/icon-tint color only; at ~1.6:1 on white it fails WCAG AA as text. Use --gold-ink (#B45309 light / #FFD166 dark) wherever gold needs to read as foreground text or an icon glyph on a light surface.

rules.name: The On-Brand Accent Rule
rules.body: --mint/--coral/--gold are tuned for neutral grounds, not the hero's solid --primary blue. On that surface use --mint-on-brand (#34D6A2), --coral-on-brand (#f87171), --gold-on-brand (#FFE08A) — theme-invariant like --primary itself. A -soft variant of mint/coral exists for a second, lower-emphasis figure on the same hero; never invent a third shade by hand.

rules.name: The Ranking Accent Rule
rules.body: A numbered leaderboard position is decorative ranking, not alert severity. 1st place borrows gold by convention (.rank-gold); 3rd place uses --bronze (#92400E light / #D97706 dark, matching .rank-bronze), never a new orange invented for the occasion.

rules.name: The One Interactive Blue Rule
rules.body: --primary is the only color that means interactive/brand. The static .text-brand-600 utility (#2B7CF6) is a Tailwind-JIT responsive-variant workaround, not a second brand hue.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every monetary amount renders with tabular-nums, no exceptions.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest, told apart by their border; shadow only intensifies as a response to being the primary action on screen, and even then stays soft.

dos: Do keep --primary as the only color that signals "interactive" — new UI should reach for it before reaching for any other hue.
Do use tabular-nums on every rendered money amount, no exceptions.
Do let the 1.5px --border carry a card's definition; treat shadow as a secondary, near-invisible cue.
Do reserve the Primary Action Glow for the one or two true primary CTAs on a screen — not every button with background: var(--primary) needs one.
Do keep every new color token dark-mode-complete (a light value with no .dark counterpart is an incomplete token).
donts: Don't mix severity colors — mint never appears on anything actionable, and coral never appears as mere "soon" information once it already escalated.
Don't add a second coral banner to a screen that already has one; degrade the lesser condition to a gold chip instead.
Don't reach for a sharp corner or a hard, high-contrast drop shadow anywhere — both read as off-system immediately.
Don't introduce a new blue. The .text-brand-600-family static utility (#2B7CF6) is a Tailwind-JIT workaround for responsive contexts, not license to design with a second brand blue.
Don't give category badges a palette-driven color — they intentionally read from the category's own color/bg_color fields.
